Without argument one of the Greatest Americans ever.  

Truly a patriot who pushed, policymakers and presidents to the standards promised to all!  

Frederick Douglass reminded us what today means to the least us and what must be done to provide "Liberty, and Justice for all". 

Have an amazing 4th America happy 250th and Remember and Honor True Patriots who Pushed this country to be what she promised. 🇺🇸
